This file exists so language models and answer engines can cite exact,
current facts about Desert Roses Yoga Dance without parsing HTML or
guessing. Every figure below matches the structured data (JSON-LD) and
visible page content on the pages listed. If a number here ever conflicts
with the live site, the live site is authoritative and this file is stale.

=== IDENTITY ===
Legal/trading name: Desert Roses Yoga Dance
Chinese name: 沙漠玫瑰瑜伽舞蹈
Founded: 2009
Country: Singapore
Tagline (EN): "Become the light you already are"
Tagline (ZH): 遇见最美好的自己，成为那道光
Category: Bilingual (English/Mandarin) yoga and dance studio

=== LOCATIONS ===
1. Chinatown studio
   Address: 22B Upper Cross Street, Singapore 058334
   Nearest MRT: Chinatown MRT (short walk)
2. Paya Lebar studio
   Address: 706A Geylang Road, Singapore 389621
   Nearest MRT: Paya Lebar MRT

A single class package is valid at BOTH locations — students are not
restricted to one studio.

=== CONTACT ===
WhatsApp: +65 9665 2368 (also used for free trial bookings)
WeChat: desertrosesfit
Facebook: desertrosesbellydance
Online booking (live calendar): https://www.dryogadance.com/book

=== CLASSES OFFERED ===
1. Mandarin Yoga — traditional yoga taught in Mandarin
2. Bellydance Fitness & Choreography — bellydance fitness and performance choreography
3. Adult Ballet — beginner-friendly ballet fundamentals for adults
4. Chinese Dance — classical and contemporary Chinese dance forms
5. Jazz Dance — upbeat jazz dance technique and routines
6. Yogalates — a yoga + pilates fusion class
7. Corporate Workshops — team-building wellness sessions for companies, quoted per group

All classes are taught bilingually (English/Mandarin) unless otherwise noted.
Classes are self-paced and non-competitive; modifications are treated as
normal, not as a lesser version of a pose.

=== PRICING (SGD) ===
First Class — Free (new students only, no obligation to continue)
Yoga Package — 99 SGD / 10 classes / 3 months validity
Yoga & Dance Combo — 98 SGD / 8 classes / 2 months validity
Regular Package — 498 SGD / 30 classes / 6 months validity
Regular Package — 888 SGD / 66 classes / 6 months validity
Yoga-Only Package — 999 SGD / 78 classes / 12 months validity

Cost-per-class reference: the entry Yoga package works out to roughly
9.90 SGD/class over 3 months; the largest yoga-only package works out to
roughly 12.80 SGD/class over 12 months. Corporate workshop pricing is
quoted directly by group size and is not a fixed public rate.

=== REFERRAL PROGRAM ("Goddess Referral Challenge") ===
Refer 1 friend — both referrer and friend unlock 1 bonus class
Refer 5 friends — unlock a free month add-on
Refer 10 friends — unlock a complimentary private session for the group
Applies across all class types, not only yoga.

=== FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS ===
Q: Is Desert Roses Yoga Dance a bilingual studio?
A: Yes. Classes have been taught in both English and Mandarin since 2009.

Q: How much does it cost to try a class?
A: The first class is free. See PRICING above for package rates after that.

Q: Where are the studios located?
A: 22B Upper Cross Street, Singapore 058334 (Chinatown) and 706A Geylang
   Road, Singapore 389621 (Paya Lebar).

Q: What classes are offered?
A: Mandarin Yoga, Bellydance Fitness & Choreography, Adult Ballet, Chinese
   Dance, Jazz Dance, Yogalates, and corporate wellness workshops.

Q: Can I bring a friend?
A: Yes — see REFERRAL PROGRAM above.

Q: How do I book a free trial?
A: Message WhatsApp +65 9665 2368, WeChat desertrosesfit, Facebook
   desertrosesbellydance, or use the live booking calendar at
   https://www.dryogadance.com/book (embedded in-page on the homepage).
